# config: git: prevent autoSetupRemote duplication

Stop `git_config` from appending `push.autoSetupRemote = true` on every run. **Motivation:** "prevent bloating of `.gitconfig`" — after [[DOT-348]] the file had accumulated the line twenty-five times:

```
[push]
	autoSetupRemote = true
	autoSetupRemote = true
	...
```

Every `self-update` runs [git_config](../../bin/git_config) ([[DOT-17]]), and the setting had been written with `--add` semantics instead of a replacing set.
